## Read-only fence

Today's brief only. The panel does not edit notes. It does not use the internet. It is not on any community list.

## How to leave

Disable Dex in Obsidian's community plugin list, then delete .obsidian/plugins/dex-readonly from the vault. Leftover: .obsidian/community-plugins.json may still list dex-readonly until you remove that name; the workspace layout may still show an empty Dex panel slot.
